query: What are the main kinds of issues these support tickets are about?

per_column.name: issue_category
per_column.rationale: Directly answers the query 'main kinds of issues' by providing a clean categorical axis to group and count tickets. The category set is coherent and non-trivial. All five sampled rows are correctly categorized (Billing, Authentication, Performance/Outage, Feature Request, Data/Reporting), reflecting sound readings of the source text.

per_column.name: issue_keywords
per_column.rationale: Extracted salient keywords give a finer-grained lens beneath the category, useful for spotting recurring themes within kinds of issues. Somewhat redundant with issue_category and noisy/inconsistent, lowering leverage a bit, but still a distinct axis. Sampled keyword sets are well grounded in the source text (invoice/ach, sso/session, 502/outage, pin/competitor, csv/export).

judge.rationale: issue_category squarely serves the analytical query, offering the primary grouping needed to identify main issue kinds; issue_keywords adds a secondary, somewhat redundant but still useful thematic dimension. Both columns' values are soundly derivable from the source issue descriptions with no observed hallucinations across the samples.
